Home.title: I'm Leandro Leite — Back-End Developer with experience building modern applications.
Home.description: I have a degree in Information Systems and work as a developer, with experience in both back-end and front-end development. I build modern web solutions focused on performance, organization, and best practices. I enjoy programming, continuously learning, and turning real-world problems into well-built software.

journey.title: My Journey
journey.paragraph1: I work as a software developer, focusing on both back-end and front-end development, creating well-structured and functional applications designed to solve real-world problems. Programming is something that truly motivates me, and I constantly strive to improve both technically and in the way I approach solutions.
journey.paragraph2: My background as an electronics technician gave me a solid foundation in logic, analysis, and problem-solving. I recently completed my degree in Information Systems, consolidating my professional career in software development.

Projects.title: My Projects
Projects.description: Some of the projects I have developed throughout my career, applying best practices, architecture, and modern technologies.

workoutPlan.title: Workout Plan – Workout Planning Platform
workoutPlan.description: Workout Plan is a web application designed to help users create, organize, and track personalized workouts. The platform allows users to select exercises by muscle group, body part, or equipment using data from an external API, while providing a modern and responsive interface for creating workout routines in a practical and intuitive way.

sage.title: SAGE – Emergency Alert and Management System
sage.description: The Emergency Alert and Management System (SAGE) is a software and hardware platform developed to improve assistance and safety in long-term care institutions, allowing alarms to be triggered and emergencies to be managed in real time.

bookAuctions.title: Book Auctions
bookAuctions.description: A web platform for book auctions that connects readers and collectors, allowing users to create auctions, track bids in real time, and securely manage transactions.

eventify.title: Eventify
eventify.description: A collaborative platform for event management and group expense sharing, focused on transparency, organization, and collaboration among participants.

astro.title: ASTRO
astro.description: An educational game focused on mathematics learning, where users practice, compete against each other, and track their progress through a ranking system.

schedulr.title: Schedulr
schedulr.description: A web application inspired by Google Calendar, developed during a recruitment process, featuring meeting creation and management through an interactive calendar.

queroLer.title: QueroLer
queroLer.description: A Flutter mobile application for managing books users want to read, featuring authentication and integration with external APIs for searching and organizing books.
